embeds.title: Venice — $25 / month
embeds.description: A shot-timing companion for **NBA 2K27 on PS5**. One plan, billed monthly, cancel any time.

fields.name: Free 7-day trial
fields.value: No card needed. One per Discord account and one per PC. Claim it on the website, or run `/claim_trial` here.

fields.name: Then $25 / month
fields.value: Cancel any time in the [billing portal](https://billing.stripe.com/p/login/5kQ7sL0Ec4Ya5MfcFsgQE00) — you keep access to the end of the period you have already paid for.

fields.name: How to buy
fields.value:
**1.** Sign in with **Discord** at [zaeorion.com](https://zaeorion.com/#pricing) — the same account you use here.
**2.** Stay a member of this server; access is linked to that account.
**3.** Start the free trial, or subscribe for $25/month.
**4.** Unlock the app with a one-time code from [zaeorion.com/connect](https://zaeorion.com/connect).
**5.** Check it any time with `/status`.

fields.name: No licence keys
fields.value: Your access lives on your Discord account and unlocks **one PC** at a time. `/hwid_reset` gives you **3 free** PC moves; after that each reset takes one day off your subscription.

fields.name: What you need
fields.value: A PS5 with a **60 Hz capture card** or **PS5 Remote Play**, plus a Windows PC. Xbox is not supported yet.

fields.name: Questions
fields.value: Open a ticket in <#1549499767321534464>. Never post a one-time code or payment details in a public channel.
